info.title: Airport Gate Scheduler API
info.description:
REST API for automated airport gate allocation, fed by live OpenSky flight data.

**Trying the API from this page:**

1. `POST /register` — create an account (no auth required).
2. `POST /login` — exchange the credentials for a Bearer token (valid 1 hour).
3. `POST /api-keys` — create an API key using `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The key is shown once.
4. Call any data endpoint with the `X-Api-Key: <key>` header.

Errors use a consistent shape: `{"message": "..."}`, plus an `errors` object on `422` validation failures.
See the [versioning policy](https://github.com/Bee7go/gate-scheduler/blob/master/docs/API.md#versioning) for what `v1` guarantees.

get.description:
Flight-to-gate allocations with their gate and flight, filterable by
gate code and occupation window.

parameters.name: occupied_from
parameters.description: Only allocations starting at or after this date or date-time.

parameters.name: occupied_until
parameters.description: Only allocations ending at or before this date or date-time. Must not precede `occupied_from`.

401.description: API key missing, invalid, or expired.

503.description: The credential store is unreachable; authentication fails closed.

get.description:
The status of every gate — free, occupied, or maintenance — at a given
time (defaults to now), optionally filtered to a single gate.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Point in time to evaluate gate status at. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: gate_code
parameters.description: Only the status of this gate.

get.description:
Maintenance and blocking windows, filterable by gate and date range,
ordered by start time.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only windows that end on or after this date or date-time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only windows that start on or before this date or date-time. Must be on or after `from`.

post.description:
Marks a gate unavailable for a period (maintenance, cleaning, repairs).
The gate is skipped by the allocator while the window is active.

get.description:
Lightweight health summary: active gates, flights, allocations, and the
last successful sync. Responds 503 with a degraded status when the
database is unreachable.

401.description: API key missing, invalid, or expired.

post.description:
Exchange email and password for a Bearer token used on the API-key
management endpoints. The token is shown once and expires after 1 hour.

429.description: The rate limit for this endpoint was exceeded.

get.description:
Period-scoped KPIs for dashboards: gate utilization, flight allocation
rates, peak hour and day, top gates, and unavailability summaries.
The period may span at most 92 days (one full calendar quarter), since
peak detection scans the period hour by hour; aggregate across multiple
requests for longer horizons.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the reporting period (inclusive). Any date or date-time string, e.g. `2026-01-01` or `2026-01-01T06:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the reporting period (exclusive). Must be after `from` and at most 92 days later.

post.description:
Runs a flight sync in-process and returns its summary. Rate limited to
one request per two minutes per API key; responds 409 when another sync
is already running.
